# objectToString

<link-summary>Returns the internal tag of a value.</link-summary>

<web-summary>objectToString() — Returns the internal tag of a value. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/object</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function objectToString(value: unknown): string;
```

`Object.prototype.toString.call(value)`, in a form that is safe to call on anything, including `null` and `undefined`. Several guards in this library are built on it, because the tag survives crossing a frame boundary where `instanceof` does not.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description       |
| :-------- | :-------- | :---------------- |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to tag. |

## Returns

`string` — the tag, such as `"[object Array]"`.

## Examples

### Reading the tag

```javascript
objectToString([]); // => "[object Array]"
objectToString(null); // => "[object Null]"
objectToString(new Date()); // => "[object Date]"
```
